word_family.gloss: 多个梦寐以求而难以获得的目标或珍品

senses.zh_definition: 圣杯：欧洲中世纪传说中与耶稣最后的晚餐有关、成为骑士追寻对象的杯或盘。
senses.en_definition: The legendary cup or platter associated with Christ's Last Supper and sought by knights.
senses.ms_definition: Cawan atau bekas hidangan dalam legenda zaman pertengahan yang dikaitkan dengan Perjamuan Terakhir Jesus dan menjadi objek pencarian para kesateria.
senses.nuances: 宗教及文学专指通常写 Grail 或 Holy Grail。应说明这是传说中的器物，不将其叙述为已证实的历史实物。下列搭配属于马来语中的专名引述。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/grail)。

collocations.en: the legend of the Holy Grail
the quest for the Holy Grail

senses.zh_definition: 长期追求而难以实现的理想目标；极难寻获的梦寐以求之物。
senses.en_definition: A deeply desired goal or object that is difficult to attain.
senses.ms_definition: Matlamat atau benda yang amat diingini tetapi sukar dicapai atau diperoleh.
senses.nuances: 英语比喻义，常见于 holy grail；收藏语境中也可单用 grail。它表示难求且珍贵，不表示目标必定无法实现。下列 ms 字段为马来语对应表达，不是已验证的马来语固定搭配。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/grail)。

collocations.ms: matlamat utama penyelidikan yang sukar dicapai
collocations.zh: 研究领域梦寐以求的终极目标

collocations.ms: barang koleksi idaman yang sukar ditemukan
collocations.zh: 收藏者梦寐以求的珍品

etymology.historical_story: English grail came through French from Medieval Latin gradalis, a term for a vessel. Medieval legend associated the Grail with Christ's Last Supper and the quests of knights. That difficult search supplied a lasting metaphor: a grail can now be an elusive achievement or a treasured object someone longs to obtain. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/grail).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 grail 和 quest 连在一起：骑士苦寻圣杯，收藏者苦寻珍品；共同核心是“珍贵、难求、一直想得到”。
